verdict.rationale: Airbyte ships an AI Assistant inside the Connector Builder that can prefill/configure connector fields, a narrow but real form of in-product task delegation to AI, plus AI-agent-facing features (MCP servers, Connect-Ask-Act). However, this is scoped to connector building, not a general-purpose assistant that can delegate broader platform tasks (e.g. managing syncs, troubleshooting, schema changes) on the user's behalf. missing for 10: evidence of a general built-in assistant beyond connector-builder field prefill, evidence of assistant handling sync/schedule/troubleshooting tasks, independent/hands-on validation of the AI Assistant's reliability.
